class.name: MultiplayerTree
class.brief_description: The node one [member Node.multiplayer] branch is rooted at.

method.name: dispose
method.description: Clears the service registry and the roster.

method.name: raise_embedded_server
method.description: Duplicates this tree as a [constant NetwMultiplayer.ROLE_DEDICATED_SERVER] sibling named [code]Server[/code] and adds it beside this one. [codeblock] var server := tree.raise_embedded_server() var peer := ENetMultiplayerPeer.new() peer.create_server(21253) server.api.multiplayer_peer = peer [/codeblock]

members.member: The [NetwMultiplayer] this tree owns and installs on its branch.
An optional [NetwMultiplayer] implementation script, passed to [method NetwMultiplayer.make].
A game-build tag that gates admission, baked into every build. A joining peer whose tag differs is rejected during the auth handshake before it reaches the [MultiplayerAPI].
On a headless build, hosts from [member peer_class] and [member transport_settings] without waiting to be asked.
An auto-connect applied on play, in debug builds only.
The [enum NetwMultiplayer.Role] this tree intends to play.
Latency and loss to simulate on this tree's peer.
The class of peer this tree brings itself up with, such as [code]&"ENetMultiplayerPeer"[/code].
The settings [member peer_class]'s transport is created with, such as [code]{ port = 21253 }[/code] for an ENet server.
